title: Biocompatibility and Biodegradation of a Native, Porcine Pericardium Membrane. Results from in vitro/in vivo Examination
authors: Rothamel D, Smeets R, Ritter L, Dreiseidler T, Fienitz T, Zöller J. Int J Oral Maxillofac Implants 2012, 27(1):146-54.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Both native RPCM and BG are resorbed without inflammation within 8 (BG) or 12 weeks (RPCM). The compact multilayer collagen of RCPM may have positively influenced the resorption stability. *Study refers to Remotis membrane, which was a former private label of Jason® membrane. 30” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
